Some argued that Singapura was named after the "lion throne" Parameswara set up in Palembang as a challenge to the Majapahit empire, and for which he was expelled from Palembang.

Early history of Singapore.subject: International Relations
Early history of Singapore.question: While there are parallels between the mythical _____ and the historical Parameswara, they are regarded as distinct
Early history of Singapore.fact: While there are parallels between the mythical Sang Nila Utama and the historical Parameswara, they are regarded as distinct.

Early history of Singapore.subject: International Relations
Early history of Singapore.question: Singapore became part of the _____, and it was said to be the fiefdom of the legendary laksamana (or admiral) Hang Tuah
Early history of Singapore.fact: Singapore became part of the Malacca Sultanate, and it was said to be the fiefdom of the legendary laksamana (or admiral) Hang Tuah. In the 16th and early 17th century, it briefly regained some significance as a trading centre of the Malacca Sultanate's successor state in Johor whose Sultan kept a shahbandar (harbourmaster) at Kallang.
